title: CIE*16 scale-invariant directional alignment for cross-field constraints
description: Lyon section 7 line 477 explicitly uses BZK09 + CIE16 for the cross-field. PATCH-96 implemented BZK09 §3 anisotropy-based directional constraints. CIE16 is a refinement that makes the alignment scale-invariant — important for meshes with varying detail scales. Without CIE16, our cross-field will still differ from Lyon's even with §3 enabled. Lower priority than PATCH-97 + PATCH-98 since the latter close most of the gap.
definition-of-done: FaceRosyField directional constraints additionally apply CIE16 scale-invariant alignment energy on top of BZK09 §3 anisotropy threshold. Verified on rocker-arm: cross-field singularity layout matches Lyon paper figures more closely than BZK09 §3 alone.
testing-plan: 1) Fetch CIE16 paper (Campen-Ibing-Ebke-Zorin-Kobbelt 2016 Scale-Invariant Directional Alignment of Surface Parametrizations). 2) Implement scale-invariant alignment energy term. 3) Add as additional energy in MiGreedyRounding alongside smoothness energy. 4) Verify singularity count and positions on rocker-arm vs Lyon paper figures.
